race.comment: ONE LAST RESORT (1) gets the nod fresh on the strength of his Belmont Mdn second last campaign, when well-supported and beaten half a length before tackling the Karrakatta Plate before a spell. His trial this time in was good around BLUE DESTINY and with a favourable set up here, he can resume on a winning note. YAMANEX (5) is the race-fit danger, third-up after a close Open fifth over 1400m at Belmont. Back to easier company here and dropping to a sprint trip looks to hold the key. BLUE DESTINY (4) brings no race experience but has won three trials, including a recent 1000m Belmont heat, so he profiles as the debutant with the clearest winning profile. BEYOND A DOUBT (2) resumes off two winter placings, including an Open third behind Farnova on heavy ground, and a solid Lark Hill trial keeps him in the mix as a reliable place-to-win chance. BELLA ROCCIA (7) can feature from an inside draw.
